author: packs
description: Education (X8-T1) for schools, universities and training institutes; grades, timetables and attendance stay in the SIS: students and guardians with sibling families, programmes and intakes on an academic calendar, applications through stages to a decision and an offer, seats and waiting lists, fees with instalments, scholarships and sponsors, and student success alerts. Children's data is personal and guardian consent is recorded. Roles, report queries and a sidebar.
name: education

definition.description: Works prospects and applications to an offer.
definition.name: Admissions Counsellor

definition.description: Decides applications and manages seats; a person decides.
definition.name: Admissions Manager

definition.description: Owns fee plans, instalments and scholarships.
definition.name: Student Finance Officer
Education: Admissions Funnel
definition.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS applications FROM edu_application WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

definition.name: Education: Seats by Intake
definition.sql: SELECT id, name, academic_year, seats, seats_taken, seats - COALESCE(seats_taken, 0) AS seats_left FROM edu_intake WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) ORDER BY starts_on

definition.name: Education: Outstanding Fees
definition.sql: SELECT id, student_ref, academic_year, total_fee, paid_amount, balance FROM edu_fee_plan WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND balance > 0 ORDER BY balance DESC
